verdict.gold_reason: Article 24(4) of Regulation 2017/2195 states that after the balancing energy gate closure time, balancing service providers report unavailable volumes of balancing energy bids to the connecting TSO without undue delay. It adds that, if the provider connects to a DSO and the DSO requires it, the provider must also report to the DSO. This matches the reference answer.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question paraphrases "gate closure time" as "cut-off" and "balancing energy bids" as "back-up energy". The paraphrase is still readable. "Grid operator" could mean either the TSO or the DSO, but the reference answer covers both.
